input.text: Root code-reading feedback for completion tests (not an independent gate): current admit_predecessors/_verified accepts a now string captured BEFORE artifact/producer HTTP acquisition. Add an exercised case where acquisition advances the clock enough that predecessor observations become stale while the consumer credential/preview remains valid. Ensure final write cannot use that stale predecessor; re-evaluate freshness with actual post-acquisition time rather than only the initial string. Likewise preserve current consumer expiry checks. In _producer, self-review identity should compare stable user ID, not whole GitHub user dictionaries (extra optional metadata must not make the same actor look different); add the corresponding actual mismatch. For native macOS, newly created TemporaryDirectory roots may contain /var symlinks: resolve the temporary root physically before strict containment, preserving no-follow policy (T011 will check other fixtures). These are concrete boundary review points within T010; no new authorization or task scope. Continue implementation and final checks.
